chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, concerning:
About a man who urinates, he said: "He should shake it three times, then if it flows until it reaches the ساق, he should not be concerned."

key_terms.يَنْتُرُهُ: he shakes it to remove remaining drops

ai.seo_question: What should a man do after urinating according to this hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to etiquette and precaution after urination. It instructs a man to shake three times, and then if moisture continues to flow afterward, he should not give it any concern.
